title: 第25章 寒元冰拳我现在就要第26章 足足杀了涅槃殿七位顶尖天才
lines: 五连崩击，震撼上演！
五重力量的连续爆发，汇聚成破甲之拳，只见元成仟身上的冰甲碎裂，胸膛打穿。
一同受到冲击的，还有四下一众围观者的视觉神经。
“我天！”
“嘶，这怎么可能？”
关想睁大了双眼，忍不住的喊出了声：“猛啊！”
绽爆的冰晶碎屑飞舞，元成仟口中鲜血大肆喷涌，他仰面抬头，摇摇晃晃的往后退了四五米远，然后膝盖一弯，无力的跪在了萧诺的面前。
元成仟口中发出低沉的声响，他颤抖的捂着胸膛，那止不住的鲜血就跟喷泉般从他的指缝间滴出。
元成仟，败！
三品弟子前五实力的人物，此刻跪在了萧诺这位新人王的脚下。
凌沧，蓝红叶，易陌三人只觉头皮都在发麻，内心都在颤栗。
连元成仟都败了，他们三人连开口说话的勇气都没有。
“拿过来吧！”
冷漠的声音传入元成仟的耳中，后者艰难的抬起头，只见萧诺俯视着自己，一股无形的王者虎威镇压全场，元成仟仿佛看到了对方身后盘踞的一尊霸怒猛虎，危险又强大。
周边的围观者心神微紧。
不用想也知道，萧诺讨要的是赌注。
元成仟眼中涌动着凶狠的厉光，他咬了咬牙，取出一个沾血的小瓶递了过去。
萧诺接过小瓶，打开瓶塞，粗略的看了下，随之说道：“只有十枚……”
元成仟嘴唇颤抖了两下：“剩，剩下的六枚，下个月给你！”
萧诺嘴角泛起一抹淡淡的弧度：“还有呢？”
众人的目光不由的看向元成仟左手上佩戴的那件“寒元冰拳”
，这件中品灵器，亦是赌注之一。
元成仟的右手按住冰拳，然后道：“下个月……给你。”
“为何要等下个月？”
萧诺俯视对方。
“寒元冰拳内部设有一道阵法，它和我的手臂已经嵌合在一起，我需要让家族的长老打开里边的阵法，才能取下冰拳。”
元成仟沉声说道。
听完对方的解释，萧诺神情没有任何的变化。
“你的借口太低级了，我等不了下个月。”
见被萧诺识破，元成仟索性也不装了：“哼，寒元冰拳是我家族赐予我的灵器，你拿不走的……你若想要，就等上一个月吧！”
“无耻！”
后方的关想忍不住的骂了一句。
这元成仟摆明的就是不想给，可偏偏对方就这么赖下去，也拿他没有办法。
但就在这时，萧诺淡淡的说道：“不用等，寒元冰拳，我现在就要！”
话音刚落，萧诺一把抓起元成仟的肩膀，一手按住肩膀关节的同时，一手抓住寒元冰拳的护腕……
content_en:
Five consecutive collapses, a shocking performance!
The continuous bursts of five levels of power converged into armor-piercing fists. Yuan Chengqian's ice armor shattered and his chest was pierced.
Also affected were the visual nerves of the onlookers all around.
"Oh my God!"
"Hiss, how is this possible?"
"..."
Guan Xiang opened his eyes wide and couldn't help shouting: "It's so fierce!"
The exploding ice crystal fragments flew, and blood gushed out from Yuan Chengqian's mouth. He looked up and staggered back four or five meters, then bent his knees and knelt weakly in front of Xiao Nuo.
"Uh-huh..."
Yuan Chengqian made a low sound in his mouth. He trembled and covered his chest, and the unstoppable blood dripped out from between his fingers like a fountain.
Yuan Cheng Qian, defeated!
The top five most powerful third-grade disciples were kneeling at the feet of Xiao Nuo, the new king.
Ling Cang, Lan Hongye, and Yi Mo all felt their scalps numb and their hearts trembling.
Even Yuan Chengqian was defeated, and the three of them didn't even have the courage to speak.
"Bring it here!"
The cold voice reached Yuan Chengqian's ears. The latter raised his head with difficulty and saw Xiao Nuo looking down at him. An invisible king's tiger power suppressed the entire audience. Yuan Chengqian seemed to see a tyrannical tiger entrenched behind him, dangerous and powerful.
The onlookers around were slightly nervous.
You don't need to think about it to know that what Xiao Nuo wants is a bet.
A fierce glare surged in Yuan Chengqian's eyes. He gritted his teeth, took out a blood-stained vial and handed it over.
Xiao Nuo took the vial, opened the cork, looked at it briefly, and then said: "There are only ten..."
Yuan Chengqian's lips trembled twice: "The remaining six coins will be given to you next month!"
A faint curve appeared at the corner of Xiao Nuo's mouth: "What else?"
Everyone's eyes couldn't help but look at the "Han Yuan Ice Fist" worn on Yuan Chengqian's left hand.
, this middle-grade spiritual weapon is also one of the bets.
Yuan Chengqian held down the ice fist with his right hand and said: "Next month... I'll give it to you."
“Why wait until next month?”
Xiao Nuo looked down at the other party.
"There is a formation inside the Han Yuan Ice Fist. It has been integrated with my arm. I need to ask the elders of the family to open the formation inside before I can remove the ice fist."
Yuan Chengqian said in a deep voice.
After listening to the other party's explanation, Xiao Nuo's expression did not change at all.
"Your excuse is so cheap, I can't wait until next month."
"You..."
Seeing that Xiao Nuo saw through it, Yuan Cheng Qian simply stopped pretending: "Hmph, the Han Yuan Ice Fist is a spiritual weapon given to me by my family. You can't take it away... If you want it, just wait a month!"
"Shameless!"
Guan Xiang, who was at the back, couldn't help but curse.
Yuan Chengqian made it clear that he didn't want to give it, but the other party just continued to rely on it, and there was nothing he could do about it.
But at this moment, Xiao Nuo said calmly: "No need to wait, Hanyuan Ice Fist, I want it now!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Xiao Nuo grabbed Yuan Chengqian's shoulder. While holding down the shoulder joint with one hand, he grabbed the wrist guard of Han Yuan Ice Fist with the other hand...
title_en: Chapter 25 I want Han Yuan Ice Fist now Chapter 26 Killed seven top geniuses in Nirvana Palace
